answer: Give the agent economy one narrow inlet: new identities join through a public queue that admits a fixed number per epoch, and each must complete its own unsubsidized task while waiting. Subsidies are the oasis attackers crave, so nobody reaches them until their place in line matures. A farm of a thousand fake agents then waits months behind honest ones, and any burst sends a visible ripple through queue length, prompting auditors to inspect that cohort before admission.
